data.one_liner: A Flutter package to display a list of widgets in a curved fashion horizontally or vertically.
data.what_it_does: Curved Carousel renders a list of widgets in a curved layout with support for horizontal and vertical orientations. It features customizable item scaling, automatic scrolling, and infinite scrolling capabilities.
use_when: You need to display a carousel of items arranged along a curve.
You require both horizontal and vertical curved carousel orientations.
avoid_when: You need standard linear or flat carousels without curvature.
strengths: Supports both horizontal and vertical listing.
Includes built-in features for automatic movement and infinite scrolling.
Customizable scaling and tilting parameters for items.
weaknesses: Limited documentation beyond basic attribute lists.
Only a single category of use-case (curved carousels).
